num_products: <int> Number of products the company sources and sells.
num_facilities: <int> Number of manufacturing facilities available for production.
num_production_levels: <int> Number of production levels available for each product-facility pair.
num_scenarios_per_distribution: <int> Number of scenarios in each probability distribution.
num_yield_distributions_per_product: <int> Number of yield-and-demand distributions per product, equal to the number of production level combinations across facilities.
num_total_distributions_per_product: <int> Total number of distributions per product, including both yield-and-demand and demand-only distributions.

products.expected_demand: <float> Expected demand quantity for this product.
products.sale_price: <float> Revenue earned per unit of this product sold at full price to meet demand.
products.discounted_price: <float> Revenue earned per unit of this product sold at a discount when inventory exceeds demand.

facilities.capacity: <float> Maximum total volume of raw materials that can be allocated to this facility across all products.

product_facility_data.product_id: <int> Identifier of the product this entry pertains to.
product_facility_data.facility_id: <int> Identifier of the facility this entry pertains to.
product_facility_data.manufacturing_cost: <float> Per-unit cost of allocating raw materials for this product at this facility.
product_facility_data.yield_distribution_type: <int> Category of yield distribution governing production outcomes for this product at this facility.

production_levels.lower_bound: <float> Minimum volume of raw materials that must be allocated if this production level is selected.
production_levels.upper_bound: <float> Maximum volume of raw materials that may be allocated if this production level is selected.
production_levels.yield_mean: <float> Mean of the yield distribution when this production level is active at this facility.
production_levels.yield_std: <float> Standard deviation of the yield distribution when this production level is active at this facility.

products_distributions.product_id: <int> Identifier of the product this set of distributions pertains to.
products_distributions.num_distributions: <int> Number of distributions available for this product.

distributions.type: <str> Whether this distribution covers both yield and demand ('yield_and_demand') or demand only ('demand_only').
distributions.level_combination: <list[int], length num_facilities> Production level that must be active at each facility for this distribution to apply, or null for demand-only distributions.
distributions.num_scenarios: <int> Number of scenarios in this distribution.

scenarios.scenario_id: <int> Identifier of this scenario within the distribution.
scenarios.probability: <float> Probability weight assigned to this scenario.
scenarios.yields: <dict, key: '{facility_id}'> Fraction of allocated raw materials that becomes usable finished goods at each facility in this scenario; present only for yield_and_demand distributions.
scenarios.demand: <float> Realized customer demand for this product in this scenario.
